text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis's running was breathtaking. 
Overflowing with fighting spirit, she 
utterly overwhelmed the others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing this, who could ever imagine there 
was once a time 
when health issues kept her from running 
at all?
choice_data_list: (What was I even worrying about?)
(What was I even worrying about...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I see the path ahead.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally, it will not be an easy 
challenge. 
Yet beyond it lies a future in full 
bloom.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, the plan to take it in hand is set. 
Be ready, G1—tied with a bow and waiting 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. It begins here. 
Shall we discuss the path we are to take?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, let me ask you: to elevate our 
club, 
which race should we challenge?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of her goals was to "bring a G1 
victory 
home to the club." That was precisely why 
I, too, 
spoke with steady resolve.
choice_data_list: Let's make a bid for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Let me hear your reasoning.
choice_data_list:
Because those are the G1s you ought to 
win.

Because those are the G1s you ought to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Triple Tiara" route aims for the Oka 
Sho, 
the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These three races are open only to 
Classic-class horsegirls— 
and to begin with, one cannot even enter 
without 
achieving certain results by the spring.
choice_data_list:
Aiming for them is a challenge in and of 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hence, it is all the more worthy of 
adorning our club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Phalaenopsis's words, 
my own determination solidified once more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet... the Classic races broadly follow 
two paths. 
Why did you choose the Tiara?
choice_data_list:
The Classic Triple Crown route... I 
wrestled with it, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic Triple Crown" route, aiming 
for the 
Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka 
Sho. 
That, too, is a worthy stage to display 
one's prowess, but...
choice_data_list:
The Tiara route better aligns with your 
goals.

The Tiara route better aligns with your 
goals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis's wish to "turn our club into 
a beautiful garden" 
essentially breaks down into two distinct 
goals 
she hopes to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One is to bring more juniors into the 
club. 
The other is to have those juniors shine 
in races, 
filling the club with the blossoms of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking those aims into account, 
the Triple Tiara was the ideal path for 
her. 
For Tiara horsegirls—
choice_data_list:
Many often go on to excel at guiding the 
next generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Take Air Groove, for example. As the 
Student Council 
vice president, she actively mentors 
younger students 
at the academy and serves as an exemplary 
role model.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her way of life closely mirrored 
Phalaenopsis's vision 
of gathering and mentoring newcomers 
for her club in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There was also the question of 
distance. 
For Phalaenopsis, who is not suited for 
long distances, 
the 3,000 meters of the Kikuka Sho would 
be harsh.
choice_data_list:
Taking all that into account... what do 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Ah, splendid.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara. A fine endeavor indeed. 
It will be no simple feat—and that is 
precisely why!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such grand ambition shall serve as 
kindling for my fighting spirit. 
Unless I surmount high walls, these legs 
can never be truly honed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore... Trainer. You have forgotten 
one other reason to pursue the Tiara, have 
you not?
choice_data_list: Wait, there's another reason?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Quite a simple matter. 
Cherry blossoms, oak, and autumn flowers—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A riot of blossoms. Only by gathering such 
magnificent blooms 
can we truly have a "beautiful garden," 
can we not?
choice_data_list: ...Haha. Yeah, you're right!
...Aha. Yeah, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then. That means 
our very first objective is...
choice_data_list: Cherry blossoms. The Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If that be the case—we must first come to 
"know."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic races" that one may challenge 
only once in a lifetime... 
We must grasp just how high that wall 
truly stands.
choice_data_list: ...? Do you have an idea in mind?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
I have a certain "veteran" in mind.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for taking your time, Brian. 
You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Cut the chatter. 
Let's get started.
choice_data_list: (Narita Brian...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling her "experienced" would be a vast 
understatement. 
She ran the Classic Triple Crown campaign 
and seized 
all three titles—the undisputed champion 
of her era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turns out Narita Brian is related to 
Phalaenopsis, 
which is likely why she agreed to lend a 
hand, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she has stepped back from the 
front lines... 
her sheer presence and aura on the track 
were on another level.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It may be needless advice to one such as 
yourself, 
but... pray, do not hold anything back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Hmph. Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaaaahhh—!" 
"......Hah!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! 
I cannot reach her...?! Brian...!!!
choice_data_list:
(...She's every bit as formidable as 
expected!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One had only just debuted, while the other 
was a seasoned 
veteran. Yet even setting that gap aside, 
the difference 
felt far more fundamental than experience 
alone...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...! 
*cough*, *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: ...E-Er... Good work out there!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaahhhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha. So this is the wall I must set my 
eyes upon... I see. 
As I am now, it is sheer arrogance to even 
harbor regret.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It was not merely that I fell short. It 
felt as though 
she declared that, like this, I could 
never catch her in a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Exhilarating.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Did you burn it into your eyes, Trainer? 
The disparity that lies between us. The 
distance that must be bridged.
choice_data_list:
I saw firsthand just how powerful a Triple 
Crown horsegirl is...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I am glad to have matched strides 
with her. 
Not merely to learn the height of this 
wall, but 
on a personal level as well—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Once I debuted and became a true 
competitor, 
I had always wished to cross blades with 
her at least once.
choice_data_list:
Did you have a particular reason you 
wanted to challenge Brian?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She is the one—the opponent who 
made my very 
soul quiver with the desire to one day 
best her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
She was the roaring inferno that set 
ablaze 
the passion for racing dwelling within my 
soul.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As a child running through the fields 
alongside her— 
she eventually rose to greatness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown. The ultimate 
achievement. 
Yet that was not what captivated my gaze.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It was her running. A stride steeped in 
rapacious hunger. 
Brian was ever in search of the truly 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—To devour them. To make them flesh and 
blood. 
In that nature of hers, laying her bare 
instincts completely naked...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I saw beauty. That a horsegirl could bring 
all others to their 
knees and seize victory through pure, 
unadulterated yearning alone.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why it had to be Brian.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—To catch the monster who scorched my very 
being.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To claim the Somei Yoshino, 
that is what I perceive I must do.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You have no objections, do you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Not at all, I'm with you!
Yeah, you got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is a towering wall, but if 
she can grow 
strong enough to contest even her, 
Phalaenopsis's true 
abilities will undoubtedly reach 
extraordinary heights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, issues like her inverted body 
temperature remain. 
So rather than rushing to sharpen her for 
immediate races, 
in order to eventually catch up—
choice_data_list:
For now, let's focus on building up your 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...You will set no specific race as our 
objective?
choice_data_list: That's right.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First start with basic training to build 
stamina. 
Once she develops enough strength to truly 
display 
her capabilities in a race, that is when—
choice_data_list:
We'll enter races and earn our ticket to 
challenge. Let's take it at that pace.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. You are right; it seems 
that previous race made me overly hasty.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To catch Brian, and to wear the cherry 
blossom crown— 
I shall continue to place my trust in you.
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave it to me!
You can count on me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First comes the first crown. And so began 
the days of building strength toward the 
Oka Sho!
